RS Janus Obsevation.description: An orbital research station monitoring weather systems, atmospheric toxins, and magnetic disturbances across Pandora. Its sensor network provides essential forecasts for surface expeditions and tracks potentially dangerous chemical storms.

RS PBA.description:
Prometheus Biochemical Annex
A heavily shielded laboratory studying Pandora’s corrosive atmosphere, reactive seas, and unusual catalytic compounds. Its researchers specialise in industrial chemistry, environmental protection, and hazardous-material containment.

RS Aegis.description: A restricted facility investigating microbial and extremophile life found beneath Pandora’s toxic clouds. The station develops medical treatments, protective organisms, and biological filters, but several experiments remain under military classification.

1784360456309.name: Epimetheus
1784360456309.description: Epimetheus is a violently active volcanic world whose fractured crust exposes vast magma seas and mineral-rich fault zones. Automated extraction sites harvest rare metals from its cooling ridges, though eruptions and magnetic storms make long-term operations hazardous.

Pandora.name: Pandora
Pandora.description: Pandora is a dense, cloud-wrapped world with corrosive seas and a poisonous atmosphere rich in complex industrial compounds. Shielded research stations study its unusual chemistry, while frontier prospectors risk the surface in search of rare catalysts and biological anomalies.
